data.one_liner: A pure Dart implementation of Rust patterns like Result, Option, Cell, Slice, and Array.
data.what_it_does: Facilitates functional programming and error handling in Dart by providing Rust-inspired types such as Result, Option, Cell, Slice, Array, and Iterator. Note that the project has been renamed to 'rust'.
use_when: You want Rust-style error handling with Result and Option types in Dart
You need functional programming helpers and patterns familiar to Rust developers
avoid_when: You want to use the package under its newer name 'rust
You do not need Rust-inspired patterns in your Dart codebase
strengths: Provides pure Dart implementations of Rust patterns
Includes helpful types like Result, Option, Cell, Slice, Array, and Iter
weaknesses: Limited documentation in the provided text
